title: Tight parking spots and maneuvering
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on maneuvering in tight spaces, with clear praise for parking assistance and easy handling but many fragments that mention tightness or parking without a firm sentiment classification.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise sensors, compact size, and easy handling that make tight parking and turns easier.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention tight spots, interior tightness, and convenient turning, but the examples are insufficient to classify them consistently as praise or criticism.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence about the dominant sentiment.
Some fragments mix different ideas such as parking assistance, cabin space, and turning radius, so the topic is only loosely coherent.
The samples are stratified and not representative estimates of overall owner experience.
